subject: Interview Invitation: Senior Software Engineer Role
body:
Dear Alok,

I hope you're doing well. After reviewing your impressive background in Python and Large Language Models, I'm excited to invite you for an interview for our Senior Software Engineer position.

Your work on the 'AI-Powered HR Agent' aligns perfectly with our tech stack. We'd love to discuss your experience in more detail.

Best regards,
Recruitment Team

subject: Update regarding your application
body:
Hi John,

Thank you for your interest in the position. While we were impressed with your portfolio, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose skills align more closely with our current requirements.

We wish you the best of luck in your career journey.

Sincerely,
HR Department
